title: Stub (naive SVG reference)
description: A deliberately naive SVG tree viewer written for the harness: it implements the whole test API and is the lower performance reference and the template for adapters.

applied: node, branch, label and background colours from the GBIF tokens through gbifTheme() (bg1, fg1, fg2)
highlight and selection in --color-primary; bar columns in the periwinkle categorical colour
tip labels in --font-body, italic (scientific names); column text and headers in --font-body
dark theme from gbifDarkTheme() (derived from tokens; GBIF defines no dark set)
runner tokens (background, foreground, branch, highlight, fontFamily) override the defaults via CSS custom properties
page chrome (header with logo, cards, buttons, tabs-pill, footer band) from gbif-tokens.css classes
styling.notes: Own renderer, so every style is controllable; this says nothing about real libraries. Branch width and dot sizes are fixed px (no token for them). Hover colour and tooltip are not implemented.
